visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a graphic showing a severe close-up of facial skin with red, inflamed papules and pustules. A woman with short brown hair, glasses, and a beige sweater is overlaid in the bottom right, pointing her finger at the skin issues. (2) The scene shifts to a bright indoor office where the woman is seated at a desk; she looks directly at the camera, gesturing with her hands as she speaks. Behind her is a professional setup with a lamp, a framed photo, and a YouTube silver creator award. (3) Transitions back to the macro skin close-up, now featuring large variety-show style text overlays. The woman's overlay remains, continuing her physical gestures. (4) The woman is shown in a medium shot holding up specific skincare products: a white tub of '2% SA' pads and a bottle of tea tree oil, rotating them to show the labels to the camera. (5) A split-screen comparison appears, showing 'Before' (red, bumpy skin) and 'After' (clearer, smoother skin) of a patient's face. (6) The video concludes with a static informational screen featuring the 'DRX' logo, social media handles, a phone number, and physical addresses on a textured off-white background.
